title: Largest Dark Matter Map Revealed

scenes.text: Astronomers just completed the biggest dark matter map
The map combines data from the DESI and Euclid surveys
scenes.label: ALL‑SKY SURVEY

scenes.text: It charts the distribution of over a billion galaxies
scenes.label: OVER ONE BILLION GALAX

scenes.text: The map reveals filamentary structures shaping dark matter
scenes.label: NEW CLUES ON COSMIC ST

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: The new all‑sky dark matter map visualizes the hidden scaffolding of the universe. Follow for daily science!
